sections.title: Positioning
sections.summary: Klaviyo has repositioned from email marketing to an 'autonomous B2C CRM' led by two AI agents. Older product pages still sell email on ROI, so the story is mid-transition.

facts.text: Category claim on the homepage.
facts.quote: THE AUTONOMOUS B2C CRM

facts.text: Lead promise is Composer, the AI marketing agent.
facts.quote: Composer turns customer data into revenue. You approve the plan, and every result is measured.

facts.text: Enterprise page repeats the CRM frame.
facts.quote: The B2C CRM built for modern enterprise

facts.text: The Email product page still leads with an ROI number.
facts.quote: Email marketing that delivers wins—and 63x avg ROI

sections.title: Products and offerings
sections.summary: Two agents sit on one data platform: Composer (marketing) and Customer Agent (service). Under them are classic channels (email, SMS, push), flows and segmentation, plus social, reviews, a customer hub and a helpdesk.

facts.text: Composer plans, builds and audits for the marketer.
facts.quote: Composer combines your business context, Klaviyo’s marketing expertise, and your connected tools to plan your calendar, build your campaigns, audit your flows, and tell you what to do next.

facts.text: Composer keeps a human approval step.
facts.quote: Composer analyzes, audits, drafts, and automates. You review, then decide what’s next.

facts.text: Customer Agent covers service and selling.
facts.quote: Customer Agent resolves 65% of questions autonomously.

facts.text: Service page argues against ticket deflection.
facts.quote: Most service tools are built to deflect tickets. Klaviyo helps every conversation do more, with opportunities to recommend products, recover carts, and keep customers coming back.

facts.text: Email personalisation draws on a built-in data platform.
facts.quote: Personalize every email with purchase history, browsing behavior, and predicted value—all powered by the built-in Klaviyo Data Platform.

gaps: Flows, segmentation, SMS and forms pages were in the nav but only two product pages were read.

sections.title: Pricing

facts.text: Free plan limits.
facts.quote: Up to 250 active profiles and 500 emails per month

facts.text: Free plan includes a small AI allowance.
facts.quote: $10 of Composer usage per month

facts.text: Free plan includes a Customer Agent allowance.
facts.quote: Customer Agent with 10 resolutions per month

facts.text: Email plan from $20 for the first tier.
facts.quote: Grow with email. Automate campaigns and build subscribers. $20 /month

facts.text: Marketing plan list and promo price.
facts.quote: $25 $1 /month

facts.text: The promo is limited and capped by profile count.
facts.quote: Limited time: Get your first month of an eligible Klaviyo Marketing Plan for just $1, for up to 5,000 active profiles.

facts.text: Above 150,000 profiles, pricing is custom.
facts.quote: Running at scale, or several brands? Talk to sales to build your custom plan.

facts.text: Billing unit is reachable contacts.

gaps: Prices above the first profile tier sit behind a slider and were not captured.
SMS and Composer add-on prices were not shown.

sections.title: Technical platform
sections.summary: A public developer site with API reference, SDKs for server and mobile languages, a CLI, an MCP server and an agent-ready docs index. Enterprise copy stresses custom objects, 400+ integrations and warehouse sync.

facts.text: API reference scope.
facts.quote: Every endpoint, with its parameters, request and response bodies, and an example request.

facts.text: SDK coverage.
facts.quote: Klaviyo offers SDKs for server-side languages (Python, PHP, Ruby, Node) and mobile platforms (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter).

facts.text: Agent connection options.
facts.quote: Connect your AI agent to Klaviyo's docs, OpenAPI spec, MCP server and CLI.

facts.text: Docs are published for machines too.
facts.quote: An index of every page is at https://developers.klaviyo.com/llms.txt.

facts.text: Extensibility claim for enterprise.
facts.quote: Custom objects, APIs, and 400+ integrations extend it without heavy engineering.

facts.text: Positioned beside the customer's own stack.
facts.quote: Klaviyo works with your warehouse, CDP, models, and agents instead of replacing them.

gaps: Rate limits and webhook behaviour were not read.

sections.title: Company presentation
sections.summary: The newsroom shows a company in expansion: a headless platform launch, an AI-agents launch, a Google partnership, new regional headquarters and a new CPO after an acquisition. Customer proof is outcome-led with named brands.

facts.text: Platform opens to agents.
facts.quote: Klaviyo goes Headless, Opening its Platform to Agents and Marketers Wherever They Work

facts.text: Strategic partnership.
facts.quote: Klaviyo and Google Announce Strategic Partnership to Power Autonomous Customer Experiences

facts.text: Leadership change tied to an acquisition.
facts.quote: Klaviyo Appoints Elias Torres as Chief Product Officer Following Strategic Acquisition of Agency Team and Technology

facts.text: Customer outcome on the stories page.
facts.quote: Thirdlove drives 15x SMS ROI after consolidating email and SMS in Klaviyo

facts.text: Customer quote presents Klaviyo as the system of record.
facts.quote: For us, Klaviyo is our CRM and our CDP, and it allows us to take data-backed actions to reach our customers.

facts.text: Brand-count claim.
facts.quote: Powering 200,000+ relationship-driven brands

gaps: No About page surfaced; the newsroom was the company page.

jtbd_fit.evidence: Pages for service, abandoned cart recovery and email each name a specific job; home names two agents for two jobs.

capability_visible.evidence: Free plan makes the product tryable; Composer prompt library and product tours are public. Product UI itself is behind signup.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Free, $20 and $25 plans plus a separate page explaining the billing unit. Higher profile tiers are behind a slider and add-ons are not priced.

product_breadth.evidence: Two agents plus channels, flows, reviews, helpdesk and a customer hub; the CRM label stretches across products whose pages still sell email.

platform_depth.evidence: Public API reference, seven SDK languages, CLI, MCP server and an llms.txt index; custom objects and 400+ integrations for enterprise.

time_to_value.evidence: Capture stops at the signup form.

friction.evidence: One click from home. First screen asks only for an email or Google; password and store details come later.

trust.evidence: Named brands with outcomes (Thirdlove, Dermalogica) plus analyst mentions. Brand-count appears on several pages.

mobile.evidence: Phone captures exist for home and pricing but were not assessed.

states.evidence: No error or empty states reached.

value_prop_clarity.evidence: 'Autonomous B2C CRM' and 'AI marketing agent' are category language; the subhead explains the job.

proof_quality.evidence: Customer outcomes are named, but '63x avg ROI' and '65% resolved autonomously' have no method on the page.

persuasion_integrity.evidence: The $1 first-month offer states its cap and that it is limited time.

cta_logic.evidence: 'Sign up' plus 'View pricing' appear together on product pages; enterprise swaps in 'Talk to sales'.

company_narrative.evidence: Homepage says AI agents and CRM; the Email page still sells email ROI. Newsroom supports the agent story.

read.summary: A company mid-reposition: the homepage and newsroom sell autonomous AI agents on a CRM, while product pages and the pricing grid still read as an email platform. Platform openness and a real free plan are the strongest parts.
pros: A free plan with allowances for every new product lets a merchant try the whole stack.
Developer site is open: API reference, SDKs, CLI, MCP server, llms.txt.
Signup starts with only an email or Google.
Promo pricing states its cap and duration.
cons: The CRM and agent story is not carried onto the Email product page, which leads with ROI.
'63x avg ROI' and '65% resolved' have no method shown.
Prices beyond the first profile tier require using a slider.
read.howItSells: Sells autonomy with oversight: AI agents that do the work while the marketer approves. Supports it with a free tier, named brand outcomes and an open developer platform.
copy: Include small allowances of every new product in the free plan.
State the cap and end of a promo price.
avoid: A new category name on the homepage while product pages use the old one.
Headline ROI numbers with no method.
unknowns: Add-on prices for SMS, Composer and Customer Agent.

hypothesis.statement: Rewriting the Email product page headline to match the agent-led homepage ('Your AI marketing agent runs your email') will keep visitors on one story and lift page-to-signup rate.
hypothesis.guardrail: Organic search entry traffic to the page
hypothesis.decisionRule: Ship if signup-start rises by a pre-agreed margin and organic entries do not fall in a four-week split.
